integrity: Seven complete embedded artifacts include a portable exact-integer verifier. All claims and formulae use the Euclidean edge-two icosahedron normalization except the separately rescaled unit-edge truncated-icosahedron corollary.
scientific_limitations: The volume formula includes both endpoints; the complete sixty-segment equality classification is confined to 0<t<1/2. Computation is an exhaustive exact certificate justified by multilinearity and Bernstein positivity, not independent proof certification. Historical priority remains subject to independent literature assessment.
title: A sharp tetrahedral-volume polynomial and sixty movable-apex families in truncated icosahedra
